notes.title: The Early Access version of "Stonegeon" will be launched on October 27th! !
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers!

The Early Access version of "Stonegeon" will be launched on Steam on October 27th, welcome adventurers into the dungeon to explore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42374088/5a95f978652599377cecb2c45d27b4fec65691af.png

In the ancient ruins, a special magic circle leading to the dungeon suddenly appeared one day, and people attracted by the dungeon soon gathered in this ruins. As one of the adventurers attracted to the dungeon, can you survive the battle with the powerful monsters in the dungeon and explore the secrets hidden in the deepest part of the dungeon?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42374088/29a3c37d38efa1055172af192efcc4f2fc07de6d.png


The game is still in the Early Access stage, if you encounter Bug in the game, please feel free to submit to us
Bug submission email: gundamwzc@163.com
